canonical_name: CycleQD -- Agent Skill Acquisition for Large Language Models via CycleQD (ICLR 2025) (So Kuroki and Taishi Nakamura and Takuya Akiba and Yujin Tang; Sakana AI; 2024-2025)
lineage: README names no predecessors. Code provenance comments: evaluator 'fishfarm' is a Sakana AI package (author Takuya Akiba, takiba@sakana.ai; references https://github.com/SakanaAI/fishfarm/issues/58) vendored here; DBBench and OS-Interaction tasks ported from THUDM/AgentTuning AgentBench.old; evalplus data loading 'Based on' ise-uiuc/magicoder; imports/logging utilities from optuna. ModelwiseLinearMerge docstring: 'Also called chat vector merge.' Seed models are SakanaAI Llama-3-8B-Instruct OS/Coding/DB experts on the meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct base. || main loop (reader, from the code): run_qd seeds one MAP-Elites-style archive per task by evaluating the expert seed models, then for each generation picks the next task in a fixed cycle (flip_interval), has a worker sample two parents from that task's archive, merge them as weighted task vectors on the shared base model (ModelwiseLinearMerge), add Gaussian (or SVD-structured) noise, evaluate the child on all tasks via vLLM, and insert the child into every task archive cell (indexed by the other tasks' scores binned as behaviour characteristics) where its quality beats the incumbent, optionally letting a per-task CMA-ES adapt the merge/mutation hyperparameters from the child's fitness.

entry_points: main.py main (hydra entry: sets up Celery in solo/worker/main mode, wandb.init, then run_qd)

main.py run_qd (the QD loop: evaluates seed models to seed per-task archives, then for num_generation generations dispatches merge_models jobs, cycling the target task every flip_interval, inserts improved children into each task's MAP-Elites-style archive_map, saves archive JSON + elite-map PNG per generation, deletes stale model dirs)

main.py Worker.merge_models (one QD step on a GPU worker: sample two parents from the target-task archive, crossover.merge -> mutator.mutate -> _eval_model on all tasks, compute quality + behaviour-characteristic bin ids, save child with save_pretrained only if it improves some archive cell; optional per-task CMA-ES ask/tell over merge+mutation hyperparameters)
crossover/model_linear.py ModelwiseLinearMerge._merge (task-vector arithmetic: child = base + sum(w_i * (parent_i - base)) / sum(w), w ~ Normal(1+mean, std))

mutation/gaussian_mutator.py GaussianMutator._mutate and mutation/svd_uniform_mutator.py SVDUniformMutator._mutate (add Gaussian noise to every tensor, or add U diag(rand*s) V^T from a precomputed task-vector SVD)
sampler/elite_sampler.py EliteSampler.sample and sampler/random_sampler.py RandomSampler.sample (parent selection from the archive, quality- and bin-weighted or uniform)

tasks/base.py BaseTask.get_q_and_bc / tasks/mbpp.py MBPPTask / tasks/agentbench_os.py AgentBenchOSTask / tasks/agentbench_db.py AgentBenchDBTask (evaluation-only: run fishfarm task on the vLLM model, return quality and BC bin ids)
utils/helpers.py load_hf_params_to_vllm (copies HF state_dict tensors into the live vLLM engine so merged weights can be evaluated without reloading), save_archive_map, plot_elite_map

example.input: configs/config.yaml (hydra): base_model_path meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct; three SakanaAI Llama-3-8B-Instruct expert seed models; tasks agentbench_os, mbpp, agentbench_db; qd.num_generation 1200, flip_interval 1, use_cma False; crossover ModelwiseLinearMerge std 0.01; mutation GaussianMutator rate 0.0003; sampling RandomSampler seed 42
example.output: Hydra output dir with models/gen_<N>/ (safetensors checkpoints of archive-improving children), archives/gen<N>_archive_map.json (per-task dict of BC-bin tuple -> {model_path, quality, sampling_freq}), images/gen<N>_elite_map_train.png, plus wandb logs; README gives no sample output
